description: A data-item or table VALUE clause in the linkage or file section or on an EXTERNAL item — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 145: "VALUE clause ignored in external data items and in linkage and file sections. The data-item and table formats of the VALUE clause may be specified in data descriptions in the linkage section and in the file section and for items described with the EXTERNAL clause." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitValueClause (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
